title: Characteristics of computers
competency: List and explain the characteristics of computers.

keywords.def: A computer works without tiredness or loss of concentration.
A computer can do many kinds of work with the same accuracy and efficiency.
A computer gives the same result for the same data.
A computer cannot work without instructions from the user.

en.text: Computers have strengths and limits. They are fast (millions of instructions per second), accurate (errors come from wrong data), diligent (never tired), versatile (many kinds of work), reliable (same result for same data), automatic, and can remember and store large amounts of data. But they have no IQ, needing instructions, and no feelings.

screens.title: A wrong total
screens.ask: A computer adds up 10,000 marks and gets a wrong total. What is the most likely cause?
opts: Some marks were typed in wrongly
The computer was in a bad mood
screens.after: Computers are accurate; errors come from wrong or inconsistent data ("garbage in, garbage out").

screens.title: Characteristics
paras: Speed: millions of instructions per second; operations take microseconds and nanoseconds.
Accuracy: calculations are 100% accurate; errors come from wrong data.
Diligence: no tiredness or loss of concentration.
Versatility: many kinds of work with the same accuracy.
Reliability: consistent results for the same data.
Power of remembering and storage: keeps large amounts of data as long as needed.
No IQ: cannot work without instructions.
No feeling: no emotion, taste, knowledge or experience.
